items.title: Sandisk’s stock falls as the company’s forecast doesn’t live up to high expectations
items.content: The midpoint of the company’s revenue forecast was below what analysts had been modeling.

items.title: Block slashed 40% of its workforce for AI — and its earnings suggest that’s paying off
items.content: “We can ship higher-quality products much, much more quickly,” an executive said in the wake of the company’s better-than-expected earnings report

items.title: Figma’s stock falls as the company’s AI push requires steep investments
items.content: While Figma’s consumption-based AI monetization strategy is showing promise, the company’s margins are taking a hit.

items.title: Why AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile shares are down after SpaceX’s earnings
items.content: SpaceX thinks it will be able to build wireless capabilities without massive network investments.

items.title: SpaceX’s stock falls as Wall Street gets spooked by the extent of AI spending
items.content: Morgan Stanley expects $64 billion in capital spending from SpaceX this year, as the company is dramatically ramping up AI investments.

items.title: Nvidia’s stock is basking in the glow of a high-profile endorsement
items.content: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk said his company will only use Nvidia’s chips to build its AI.

items.title: Missouri voters just rejected a bid to ditch income tax, while other tax votes loom in Florida and California this fall
items.content: Missouri voters rejected a bid to ditch the state’s income tax Tuesday, while big votes loom in Florida and California this fall.

items.title: Alphabet’s stock drops as Google loses another key AI executive
items.content: Jeff Dean, Google’s chief scientist and one of its first employees, is leaving to launch his own company.

items.title: Retail investors are buying the dip on SpaceX’s stock before more shares flood the market
items.content: Retail investors were doing what they do best on Wednesday: Buying the dip in SpaceX shares aggressively, even as the company’s stock sank after it released its first earnings report.

items.title: Aggressive options trading helped drive the S&P 500’s latest rally. What that means for investors.
items.content: The S&P 500 has enjoyed an epic rally over the past five days — but the advance may be more mechanical and driven by options positioning, rather than by an improvement in investors’ fundamental outlook.
